title: Identification of 3-aryl-5-methyl-isoxazole-4-carboxamide derivatives and analogs as novel HIF-2alpha agonists through docking-based virtual screening and structural modification.
authors: Chen, Siyuan; Liu, Yao; Wang, Zhe; Qi, Chengcheng; Yu, Yanzhen; Xu, Lei; Hou, Tingjun; Sheng, Rong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过对接虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟发现HIF-2α小分子激动剂，研究其变构增强HIF-2二聚化的机制，虽聚焦小分子-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，但涉及转录因子HIF-2的构象调控与MD方法，对TF-DNA互作机制建模有方法学借鉴价值。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factor-2 (HIF-2) serves as the pivotal transcription factor in cellular responses to low oxygen levels, particularly concerning the regulation of erythropoietin (EPO) production. A docking-based virtual screening on crystal structures of HIF-2alpha inhibitors unexpectedly identified 3-phenyl-5-methyl-isoxazole-4-carboxamide derivative v19 as a hit of HIF-2alpha agonist. Further structural optimizations of compound v19 led to the discovery of a series of HIF-2alpha agonists with novel scaffolds. The most promising compounds 12g and 14d exhibited potent HIF-2alpha agonistic activities in vitro with EC(50) values of 2.29 muM and 1.78 muM, respectively. Molecular dynamics simulations have revealed their capacity to allosterically enhance HIF-2 dimerization, which shed light on their mechanism of action. Moreover, compound 14d demonstrated a favorable pharmacokinetic (PK) profile, boasting an impressive oral bioavailability value of 68.71 %. These findings strongly suggest that compound 14d is an auspicious lead compound for the treatment of renal anemia.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子-2（HIF-2）作为细胞对低氧水平反应中的关键转录因子，尤其在促红细胞生成素（EPO）产生的调控中扮演核心角色。基于对接的虚拟筛选针对HIF-2alpha抑制剂晶体结构，意外识别出3-苯基-5-甲基异噁唑-4-甲酰胺衍生物v19作为HIF-2alpha激动剂的命中化合物。对化合物v19的进一步结构优化，发现了一系列具有新型骨架的HIF-2alpha激动剂。最具潜力的化合物12g和14d在体外展现出强效的HIF-2alpha激动活性，其EC(50)值分别为2.29 μM和1.78 μM。分子动力学模拟揭示了它们通过变构方式增强HIF-2二聚化的能力，这为其作用机制提供了启示。此外，化合物14d展现出良好的药代动力学（PK）特性，其口服生物利用度高达68.71%。这些发现强烈表明，化合物14d是治疗肾性贫血的一个有前景的先导化合物。
